narrative.overview: Extend the operator-approved visual language already implemented in admin-api/dashboard/index.html. Tonal panels and measured data carry the interface; primary actions are easy to locate without decorative effects.
dos: Keep forms inside the current context and preserve edits during refresh.
Use text with every status color.
donts: Do not describe a slip upload or checkout redirect as payment confirmation.
Do not imply dedicated public IP from a dedicated board.
